note: The vendoring route table: which upstream files, from which repo at
the shared tag, land where in the scaffold — and how they are adapted
on the way in. Hand-maintained. `node build/vendor.js` executes it and
writes ts/test/vendored.json (the manifest the guard reads); --check
`version` is HAND-SET per route: the port's own declared version at
the tag where it declares one, the tag string where it declares none.
Behaviour is pinned by tests (structnull.test.ts), never by stamps —
upstream's own in-file stamps have been stale before.
An `adapt` applies to every route file whose DESTINATION path matches
`match`; `from` must be present in the file or the run fails loudly.
haskell (packages/sdkgen-haskell) is EXCLUDED: its scaffold is outside
this write root and needs its own route root — recorded, not silent.
